name: Market clearing with a bracket that excludes the root (adversarial)
description: Deliberately broken variant of market-clearing.json: the same linear supply and demand system, but the solve bracket is [0, 5] while the true clearing price is 18. The residual has the same sign at both ends of the bracket, so no root exists inside it.
scope: Adversarial fixture for 'solver failure must be explicit' (v3 section 7). This model is expected to fail with diagnostic code solve-no-root and ok:false. It is intentionally NOT registered in src/core/fixtures.ts and should not be offered in the Lab picker. See data/core/README.md.

solves.description: Wrong on purpose: the true root (18) is outside [0, 5], so the engine must fail explicitly instead of returning a wrong price.
